name: FreeCAD
summary: The FreeCAD application itself collects no personal data. The separate FreeCAD Telemetry addon, which you must install yourself from the Addon Manager, sends non-identifying usage data (version, platform, preferences, installed addons, abnormal shutdowns) to a PostHog server in the EU run by the FreeCAD Project Association.

optOut.instructions: Don't install the Telemetry addon. If it's installed, remove it in the Addon Manager, or uncheck "Enabled" in the addon's preferences.
